title: Legi TPA
description: A clean and lightweight TPA mod for NeoForge servers.
body:
# ✨ Legicrafters TPA

A clean, feature-rich teleport request system for NeoForge 1.21.x servers.  
No bloat — just smooth, styled TPA with everything your players expect.

---

## 🚀 Features

- 🧭 */tpa <player>* — Send a teleport request to another player  
- ✅ */tpaaccept* — Accept an incoming request (also clickable in chat)  
- ❌ */tpadeny* — Deny an incoming request (also clickable in chat)  
- 📍 */tpahere <player>* — Request a player to teleport to you  
- 🛑 */tpacancel* — Withdraw your own outgoing request  
- 🔕 */tpatoggle* — Disable/enable incoming TPA requests  

---

## ⚙️ How it works

1. 🧑 Player A types `/tpa PlayerB`  
2. 💬 Player B receives a chat notification with clickable *[Accept]* and *[Deny]* buttons  
3. 📢 An actionbar message keeps the request visible  
4. 🔔 A Pling sound alerts the target  
5. ⏳ The request expires automatically after *60 seconds*  
6. 🔒 Only *one open request per player* at a time  

---

## 📦 Requirements

- 🎮 *Minecraft:* 1.21.x  
- 🛠️ *Loader:* NeoForge  
- 🌐 *Side:* Server-side only  
- 📁 No dependencies required
